input_identity.analytic_reference_scope: Nested native_case reference belongs to the original source only; no offset reference evaluated or inherited as a result

constraints.free_internal_nodes: all coordinates; original and inserted knots

mesh.inserted_node_rule: For edge e < 64 and 1 <= j < pieces: node e*pieces+j; exact barycentric j/pieces after source override, rounded once
mesh.selection: First original vertex with nonnegative projected distance at least 2 km; entire crossing edge included

analytic_reference.interpretation: Propagation time and fixed-polygon endpoint comparison; separate from optimized-ray derivative or first-arrival certification.

row.receiver_elevation_semantics: Channel/Elevation interpreted as sensor elevation per StationXML; no separate burial correction
row.receiver_identifier_basis: derived from provider SEED codes using FDSN Source Identifiers v1.0
row.receiver_metadata_epoch_basis: Intersection of provider StationXML network, station and channel epochs
row.receiver_vertical_datum_basis: NCEDC documents station elevations and catalog geoid depth on the same datum; StationXML supplies no explicit vertical-datum field
row.source_origin_resource_id_basis: provider catalog geometry reference, not a simulated pick/origin identifier
row.source_simulation_origin_time_basis: truth t=0; initial/inverted t is a simulated correction in seconds

native_case.catalog_scope: Catalog-derived simulated ray: native event/origin/channel metadata preserved; no invented native pick or arrival association.
native_case.coordinate_basis: Exact binary64 coordinates of the saved original old polygon; no resampling or merging
